q: How many days of paid annual leave do employees get?
answer:
Employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [1]. The leave is accrued at 1.5 days each month [1]. Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward to the next year; any excess lapses on 31 December [1]. Unused balance may be paid out at exit, limited to 10 days in the final settlement [1].

**Sources**
[1] Northwind Labs Employee Handbook · Leave policy

Employees also get 8 days of sick leave per year. Sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days needs a medical certificate uploaded to the HR portal. Unused sick leave does not carry forward.

answer:
You get 18 days of paid annual leave, 8 days of sick leave, 10 public holidays, and 2 optional holidays each year [1][2]. Annual leave is credited at 1.5 days per month and up to 10 unused days can be carried forward, with any excess lapsing on 31 December [1]. Sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days requires a medical certificate, and unused sick leave does not carry forward [1]. Optional holidays are chosen from the regional list published each December [2].

q: Is there a learning and certification budget?
answer:
Yes, each full-time employee has a learning budget of INR 30,000 per financial year [1]. The budget covers courses, certifications and conference tickets and must be approved by the reporting manager [1]. Certification exam fees are reimbursed only after the employee passes the exam [1]. Employees using more than INR 1,00,000 of sponsored training must sign a 12-month service agreement for that training [1].

citations.snippet:
Each full-time employee has a learning budget of INR 30,000 per financial year for courses, certifications and conference tickets, approved by the reporting manager. Certification exam fees are reimbursed after the employee passes the exam. Employees who use more than INR 1,00,000 of sponsored training in a year sign a 12-month service agreement for that training.

Every employee gets access to the company's online learning library from the first day, and new joiners complete a 5-day induction programme in their first two weeks.
